invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null list, as a new list is collected at the end.
All elements in the result list are non-null because nulls are filtered out before collecting.
Input records list is required for stream operations, so it cannot be null.
Parallelism is meant to control parallel execution and is likely expected to be positive.
Schema string is parsed and used, so it should not be null or empty.
